We checked the logs and found that PLC is unable to communicate with the AC meter BC5.
Outlet not ready - PLC has communication error with AC meter
Could you please check the ethernet connection from meter to Switch and Switch to the PLC.
This error indicates a communication issue between the PLC and AC meter.
Please plan a site visit to check the meter ethernet connection to the switch and PLC ethernet connections to the switch.
Also please carry a spare tested ethernet cable and AC meter.
AC Meter 3P 65A Direct Modbus TCP MID > 7KM2200-2EA40-1JA1

additional_info.subject: Re:‏ ID0419835-DC/Si-D/IL-[MP / P4 170000467] Communication loss CRM:02682000052
additional_info.body:
Dear Siemens Support Team,
Following your inquiry, I would like to update you that our technician visited the site. As per the request of Orel from Siemens Israel, the following actions were taken:
Two DC contactors QA13-14 were replaced at the site in Mitzpe Ramon.
The SIM cards between xf3 and xf4 were replaced.
All network cables at the station were inspected.
Please let us know if further actions are required.
Thank you for your cooperation.
Best regards,
Ziv Vinitzer
